learning_objective: 🎯 Polish your work! Learn the final, crucial step of translation where the transferred meaning is reshaped to sound perfectly natural and beautiful in the Target Language.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Translation follows a three-step model (Nida's model): Analysis -> Transference -> Restructuring. Restructuring is the final step where the raw translated material is organized to fit the stylistic rules of the Target Language.
A successful translation should not 'sound like a translation'. Restructuring ensures the text flows so smoothly that the reader believes it was originally written in their own language.

During this phase, the translator actively moves words around. They might combine two short English sentences into one flowing Hindi sentence, or change active voice to passive voice if it sounds more natural in the Target Language.

The translator checks if the restructured text matches the original tone. If the original was a humorous, fast-paced dialogue, the restructured text must have that exact same bouncy, light-hearted feel.

Restructuring involves cutting out clunky phrasing. If a literal transfer resulted in a 10-word sentence, the translator might find a 5-word idiom in the Target Language that says the exact same thing much better.

fun_activity.title: 🤖 The Robot Translator Fix
fun_activity.instructions: Type a beautiful poem or song lyric into an online automatic translator and translate it into your native language. Read the robotic, clunky output. Now, 'restructure' it yourself so it sounds poetic, natural, and human again!

exam_tips: 📌 Always mention Eugene Nida when discussing the 3-step translation process (Analysis, Transference, Restructuring).
📌 Emphasize that while 'Analysis' focuses entirely on the Source Language, 'Restructuring' focuses entirely on the Target Language and its audience.
📌 Restructuring is what separates a human translator from a basic dictionary or machine translation.
quick_recap: ⭐ Restructuring is the 'stylistic polish' applied to the raw transferred meaning.
⭐ The ultimate goal of restructuring is complete invisibility of the translator.
⭐ Grammar, sentence length, and vocabulary choices are all finalized in this stage.
